lines: [d7] Back at the haven the argument starts: Carmela is calling it "The Loud Beast." They'll fight it out — weigh in if you want.
[d7] Night settles. The fire is the whole world now. No watches posted. The dark feels bigger than it should.
[d7] 🎁 "We watched your first week! You're good at... let us see..." (A gift awaits — choose an ability.)
[d7] 🕐 Your hand-drawn time-circle glitches — and something colder, more precise, takes its place. (We kept the smudges. They're charming.)
[d7] 🦎 "Those were CALIBRATION fauna! First drafts! The audience has NOTES! So we made BETTER ones!" (Something new is crying in the treeline.)
[d7] "So we made it OFFICIAL! The PARTY SYSTEM! Up to THREE companions! Formal! Tracked! With a UI! The audience can see your party composition now! Very important for the betting markets!"
[d7] A new option appears when you look at people: invite them to your party.
[d7] 💡 Learned: PARTY SYSTEM. You can invite people to travel and fight beside you. Ask — in conversation, like a person.
[d7] 🍽️ Sofia peeks into the pantry, then turns the foraging party back. "Plenty for days. Teaching the kids snares instead — they'll need to know."
[d7] 🍽️ Aki taps the pantry door — full to bursting — and keeps the day's share in hand. "Dinner's on me tonight, then."
[d8] The Mountain Lord stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
[d8] "We've been watching you figure things out all week! This one's on us — a head start! But the REAL power? That comes from UNDERSTANDING. Use it! Learn it! The gamblers are watching!"

[d8] ◈ ARC II — THE SHOW. The sky tore open a week ago and the village is still here. Still eating. The audience has noticed. Strangers will come — not because the plot says so, but because surviving is worth watching.

[d8] ◈ SYSTEM: "RATINGS DIP. The audience wants STAKES — pointed ones. A PALISADE. Stockpile 14,000 kcal, 350 wood and 60 stone. Walls make such good television. You will thank us when the teeth come."
[d8] Lungelo and Carmela lingered over the fire together.
[d8] Farid and Lungelo lingered over the fire together.
[d8] Farid and Carmela lingered over the fire together.
[d8] Benoit and Krystyna lingered over the fire together.
[d8] 🍽️ Diana looks at the full shelves and waves off the day's share. "No more into the store — we eat at the fire, and the shelves keep."
[d8] Carmela shows you The Touch — not the power, just the shape of it. Watch and learn.
[d8] 📓 Codex: you've SEEN **The Touch** now. Wounds close a little faster when your hands are on them now. Not miracles — just faster. It started days ago. You don’t know why. You’ve stopped asking.
[d9] No watches tonight. Everyone sleeps with one ear open and pretends not to.
[d9] 📋 SYSTEM QUEST: "Teach us? Show us a plant you know COMPLETELY (Codex L3) — 10 candidates in your notes. We will watch very closely. Reward: integration."
[d9] 🐗 RAID — 4 raiders (The Mountain Lord, Flashbulb Moth, Highbeam Deer, The Anaconda Empress) hit Haven in the night, drawn by the smell of the pantry! No walls. No warning but the noise.

[d9] 🚨 The Mountain Lord, Flashbulb Moth, Highbeam Deer, The Anaconda Empress is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.
[d9] 📓 Codex: The Mountain Lord, Flashbulb Moth, Highbeam Deer, The Anaconda Empress at the door, day 9.
[d9] 🛡️ Lungelo, Krystyna, Farid and Benoit met them at the door — 3 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Lungelo, Krystyna, Farid, Benoit are hurt.
[d9] Sofia and Krystyna lingered over the fire together.
[d9] 🍽️ Diana lingers by the full pantry and laughs. "Full shelves, full bellies. Mending the palisade today — the fence won't fix itself."
[d9] 🍽️ Aki carries the day's surplus to the pantry door, thinks better of it, and turns back to the fire. "It'll only rot in there. We eat."
[d9] Carmela watches how you handle pokeweed — files it away. Learning by watching.
[d10] ◈ CRISIS — THE BREACH. It got INSIDE. The haven was supposed to be the safe place — the one place. It isn’t.
[d10] The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
[d10] You don't know what that was. Stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
[d10] You STRIKE the tiger for 12.
[d10] You STRIKE the tiger for 15.
[d10] Carmela strikes the Mountain Lord.
[d10] You STRIKE the tiger for 13.
[d10] You STRIKE the tiger for 11.
[d10] Carmela strikes the Mountain Lord.
[d10] 📖 The Codex settles deeper into you. It knows things before you do now. Deaths, especially — it will tell you itself.

[d10] A tiger feeds the village for a week. The pelt is beyond price; the claws are trade and talisman both. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh. Clean it, test it cautiously, or ask someone who knows. And don't leave it long: meat rots where it lies.

[d10] ◈ "UNIT SEED PACKET — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn. You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

[d10] ◈ "UNIT WEDDING RING — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn (morale). You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

[d10] ◈ "UNIT TRAIL COMPASS — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn; harder to get truly lost. You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

[d10] ◈ "UNIT LUCKY COIN — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn (morale). You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."
[d10] ◈ TRIAL RECOGNIZED — the System has been watching. You WON a fight. Not survived — won. The audience is still standing. So are you. (Combat track +)
[d10] ◈ TRIAL RECOGNIZED — the System has been watching. You took a beating that should have ended you — and kept moving. Noted. (Combat track +)
[d10] 📺 Carmela brought down The Mountain Lord. Together. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
[d10] Benoit watches you give the order. "Interesting. Nobody asked me."
[d10] The door is quiet. Haven breathes.
[d10] ◈ CRISIS — THE SIEGE. They came in the night for the pantry — and the village met them at the door with blades and fire and drove them back into the dark. Wealth has a scent. So does defiance.
[d10] SYSTEM: "INTRUDER REPELLED. The pantry’s aroma is now classified as a defensive liability. The audience is chanting the defenders’ names. Fan clubs are forming. This is how it starts."
[d10] 📓 Codex: DeShawn proposed relief (raid), day 10.
[d10] Krystyna is sweeping ash and grit out through the door, steady strokes.
[d10] Night settles. The fire is the whole world now. No watches posted. The dark feels bigger than it should.
[d10] ⚔️ Lungelo stood down the Mountain Lord and kept walking — 6 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.
[d10] ⚔️ Krystyna stood down the Flashbulb Moth and kept walking — 2 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.
[d10] ⚔️ Benoit stood down the Anaconda Empress and kept walking — 6 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.

[d10] Carmela leans in, voice low. "Here's what we figured out about The Mountain Lord. Stand tall and shout. When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched."

[d10] 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — The Mountain Lord: Stand tall and shout. When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched. (Someone at the haven knew the trick.)

[d10] 📓 Codex: Counter: Stand tall and shout — When it crouches to pounce, STAND TALL and SHOUT — bang metal, wave your arms, be loud and enormous. It expects prey to flee. Be the thing that doesn't, and the pounce dies unlaunched.
[d10] 🗣️ Sofia to Aki, by the fire: "Stone. We need 40 more for the palisade footings. Creek beds, hillsides — pry it loose."
[d11] Back at the haven the argument starts: Carmela is calling it "Big Ugly." They'll fight it out — weigh in if you want.
[d11] Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
[d11] Farid and Lungelo lingered over the fire together.
[d11] Farid and Carmela lingered over the fire together.
[d11] Sofia and Carmela lingered over the fire together.
[d11] 🍽️ Evelyn watches another basket arrive and laughs. "We're feeding the shelves more than ourselves. Not today."
